featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.
1080P HD Wide Angle Webcam w/ AI Enhanced Lighting, Integrated Mic & App Control
1080P full HD business webcam that surpasses the video and sound quality provided by most laptops, ideal for home office or small and medium-sized meeting room.
Supports Wide Dynamic Range (WDR) for Clear Image in Any Light
Supports Windows/MacOS APP for Video Configuration & Color Adjustment

Designed with a premium lens and advanced CMOS sensor, FOCUS 100 webcam can seamlessly stream up to 1080P Full HD distortion-less image to your computer. It can also record vibrant video clips that capture the smallest details.

Built with the unique ISP image algorithm, FOCUS 100 webcam supports automatic white balance adjustment and backlight compensation. Even if you work in harsh lighting environments, you can always look bright, clear and professional in front of your clients, colleagues, and bosses.

FOCUS 100 webcam is designed with a sturdy and adjustable clip, so you can easily mount it on a laptop or external monitor. Integrated with tripod threads, you can even install it onto a tripod (not included) for complete control over your camera setup.
1. What are the main features of FOCUS 100 Webcam?

FOCUS 100 full HD webcam is equipped with a 100° wide-angle distortionless lens. It supports automatic white balance adjustment and low light compensation. It has a built-in microphone and an attached privacy cover. It is plug-n-play, and can work with Zoom, Skype, Teams, Google Meet, etc.
You can choose FOCUS 200 or FOCUS 210 webcam. They supports 8x digital zoom.

FOCUS 100 webcam's lens is fixed focus, pre-set to a specific focus range. As it is designed with 100° wide-angle lens featuring a wide depth of field (DOF), it can render everything in a scene in focus. Compared with auto-focus webcams, fixed-focus webcams allow for more precise focusing, better for macro and portrait shots, and better for low-light photography. To enrich our product line, we will release new webcams that have auto focus in the future.
We offer 24/7 global service and support. Please feel free to contact us on the phone, email or live chat! We are always happy to help.
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
